newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Unicer sees better '97 result.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Unicer sees better '97 result.

text.p: Results of Portuguese drinks company Unicer-Uniao Cervejeira are expected to be better in 1997 than in 1996, mainly because of sales growth, its president Jose Soares da Fonseca said.
"Based on the first three months of the year, expectations for results in 1997 are better than those obtained in 1996," he told Reuters after presenting the company's 1996 results.
Unicer reported a drop in 1996 consolidated profit with minority interests to 2.383 billion escudos from 3.059 billion in 1995.
Soares da Fonseca said he expected Unicer to invest between five and six billion escudos in 1997 to upgrade equipment and information technology systems.
"The strategy of the group in 1997 is based on sales growth and the reinforcement of our position in areas of the market where we still have room to grow -- namely the south," Soares da Fonseca said.
He added that Unicer planned to boost its presence in the Spanish market.
